name: PBK Team Style Evidence Pipeline
purpose: Provider-free adapter from already archived match/stat observations into an append-only team-style evidence ledger consumed by Team Style Profiles.
guardrails: The evidence pipeline performs zero provider/API calls.
Only successful observations already present in the raw archive are eligible.
The provider fetched_at_utc timestamp is preserved as observed_at_utc.
Home/away venue is derived only from explicit fixture metadata for the same fixture id.
If fixture metadata or venue cannot be established, the statistics observation is not promoted to style evidence.
Missing statistics remain absent/unknown and are never converted to zero.
Historical normalized imports require explicit aware kickoff_utc and observed_at_utc; the adapter does not invent source availability timestamps.
No evidence row creates a style score, Matchup Grade, probability/value adjustment, betting signal or stake change.
